verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Meltano is pip-installable and ships a prepackaged Docker container, and that "you host and manage everything on your own servers… free forever." Containerization guides support the self-hosted deployment path. Community posts independently describe it as open source and self-hosted, with GitLab running it in production. Missing for 10: there is no in-depth self-hosted production operations guide (scaling, upgrades, HA) in the evidence beyond the containerization and Airflow orchestration snippets.
